# GNU FreeFont (FreeSans), the fallback font of the dialogs

- Upstream: <https://www.gnu.org/software/freefont/>, release **20120503**
  (`https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/freefont/freefont-ttf-20120503.zip`, SHA-256
  `7c85baf1bf82a1a1845d1322112bc6ca982221b484e3b3925022e25b5cae89af`). The face
  is `freefont-20120503/FreeSans.ttf` (version 0412.2268, SHA-256
  `c80858440d8fb618e0ac5ff6f16251dbfa6b3316f00f3cdd17d477297dd87b04`).
- Copyright 2002, 2003, 2005, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2012 GNU FreeFont contributors
  (the Latin glyphs come from URW++; the full list is in the release's
  `AUTHORS` and `CREDITS`).
- License: **GPL-3.0-or-later**, the license of this project (`COPYING`, copied
  unmodified from the release), with the GNU FreeFont font exception:

  > As a special exception, if you create a document which uses this font, and
  > embed this font or unaltered portions of this font into the document, this
  > font does not by itself cause the resulting document to be covered by the
  > GNU General Public License. [...] If you modify this font, you may extend
  > this exception to your version of the font, but you are not obligated to do
  > so.

  The glyph table derived here is distributed under plain GPL-3.0-or-later,
  like the rest of the port (the exception is not needed: the table is part
  of a GPL program).
- What is in the repo: **not the font file**, only a table of glyphs rasterized
  from it, `profiles/mpo/host/font/fallback_font_glyphs.inc`, generated by
  `profiles/mpo/host/font/make_fallback_font.py` (both GPL-3.0-or-later). The
  table holds 208 characters: printable ASCII, Latin-1, `Œ œ Ÿ`, the
  typographic punctuation (`– — ‘ ’ “ ” • … € ™`), the four button symbols
  (`○ × △ □`) and `U+FFFD`, as 8-bit coverage at an em of 18 px (the em of the
  firmware's `ltn0.pgf`), with no hinting. The corresponding source is the font
  above (its FontForge sources are in the GNU FreeFont repository) plus the
  generator:

  ```sh
  python3 -I profiles/mpo/host/font/make_fallback_font.py --zip freefont-ttf-20120503.zip
  # or --download, or --ttf FreeSans.ttf
  ```

  The test `mpo_font_fallback_fresh` checks the table against the generator,
  and regenerates and compares it when CMake has `MPO_FREEFONT_ZIP`.
- Use: the text of the `sceUtility` dialogs (PPGe: save, load, delete,
  messages and the on-screen keyboard) when the player has no firmware PGF
  font (F23c). With the firmware fonts it is not used. `sceFont` (the game's
  own text) does not use it.
- Why this font: its license is the project's own, so there is no
  compatibility question (SIL OFL and the Bitstream Vera license, the other
  candidates, are free but are not the GPL, and both forbid selling the font
  alone); it is a Helvetica-like sans serif, close to the firmware's
  FTT-NewRodin; and one face covers all of Latin plus the four button symbols.
